verdict.rationale: PayPal offers embeddable Checkout buttons and card-field customization (Expanded Checkout with 'card field customization with your business branding') plus server-side endpoints for refunds/captures, indicating in-page rather than purely redirect-based integration. However, evidence doesn't detail a fully custom, non-redirect hosted-fields component for card entry beyond the button/card-field mention, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of styling depth or non-redirect flow is present. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of Advanced/Hosted Card Fields SDK for fully embedded card capture, independent developer corroboration of customization depth, and details on avoiding redirect entirely for all funding sources.
